intro: Vatican City holds some of the world's greatest art treasures.

chapters.title: Art treasures
text: The Vatican Museums contain works by Raphael, Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo and ancient sculptures.

chapters.title: Ceremonies
text: Huge crowds gather in St Peter's Square for papal masses at Easter and Christmas.

items.title: Sistine Chapel Choir
items.subtitle: Since the 1400s
items.text: One of the world's oldest choirs.
